notes.title: The release approaches...
notes.notes: [p]Hello![/p][p][/p][p]We are very close to the release of Five Nights At Stickman.[/p][p][/p][p]For further detail, it releases August 1st, at 7PM CEST, and 10AM PDT.[/p][p][/p][p]I've been having fun making daily posts for the last 2 weeks but...[/p][p][/p][p]Everything that begins, ends. [/p][p][/p][p]The next post will be on release day![/p][p][/p][p][/p]
